title: TheValley character package v0
description: One character = meta + public card + private card. LAW (A2, ratified): every field names the code that consumes it in x-consumer; a field that cannot name a consumer does not belong in this file. x-visibility marks which side of the Wall a field lives on. Modules are optional by default — the rung in meta decides which are required (enforced by tools/validate_schema.py, since rung rules are cross-field). Runtime state (belief ledger, meter values, chronicle, promotion history) is NOT in this schema — it lives in saves and is written only by the appraisal pass. States precedence is an engine constant, not card data: the more recent stimulus wins; the displaced state persists as texture.

rung.description: Promotion ladder position. Decides required modules (validator-enforced): walk_on needs identity only; named adds voice+quirk; recurring adds seed_beliefs or drives, one state, tells; principal adds self_concept, defense_filters, escalation, monologue. Promotion ADDS modules, never forbids them.

public.description: Narrator-visible. Nothing in here may encode vault or actual-tier material — the mask only.

identity.description: Protected, never trimmed (B1). Pipe-separated: name | age/sex | role | address forms.

capacity.x-consumer: narrator scene cards + GM plausibility checks
capacity.description: What they can do without permission | what needs sign-off | proxies | the one thing they cannot do (B6).

languages.x-consumer: narrator scene cards; lint pass (code-switch fences)
languages.description: Tier AND acquisition age, plus the explicit fence (B4). Child-acquired leaks; adult-acquired is deployed, never leaked.

voice.description: Legacy cards use prose (accepted); new cards prefer the structured form so examples are individually lintable.

quirk.x-consumer: briefing texture; promotion anchor; future idiolect anchor
quirk.description: Orthogonal, not opposed: neither follows from the archetype nor negates it. A significant absence is a valid answer (A7).

stated_faces.description: The mask, by subject. Author ONLY where stated diverges from actual — an identical pair is noise. Every key here MUST have a counterpart in private.actual_faces (validator cross-check).

fences.x-consumer: lint pass (string-scan on drafts, engine constant style)
fences.description: Negative space as data, not instruction (C6). The model never reads these as rules; the lint reads them as scan lists. 'Naturally' is licensed: a character may quote a fenced word flatly as evidence.

private.description: GM-side. Never enters the narrator's context; only computed outputs (resolved beliefs, posture, register, acting notes) cross the Wall.

sections.description: The existing v2 secret system: truth/rumor variants, sensitivity, learnable_from. Unchanged by this schema.

seed_beliefs.description: Tier 2: only load-bearing DIVERGENT beliefs — where this person departs from faction default. Divergence is computed, never authored.

internalization.x-consumer: engine/beliefs.py posture() v2 — adds the self as a permanent listener at this enforcement level (superego)
internalization.description: How hard the character enforces orthodoxy on themselves in an empty room. Moreau: lethal. Anton: none.

actual_faces.x-consumer: GM briefing (acting notes under pressure); appraisal pass (leak-through direction)
actual_faces.description: The actual halves of public.stated_faces, same keys. The gap IS the character; the harness can steer leak-through deliberately.

self_concept.x-consumer: appraisal pass — the four reference beliefs the defense filters defend; shame = distance to feared
self_concept.description: Higgins quartet. Feared drives more behavior than ideal (loss aversion). 2-6 words each.

drives.x-consumer: appraisal pass (meter updates); GM action-cost preview (posture generalized)
drives.description: The id. Negative constraints compile HERE, never as prohibitions: 'ashamed of weakness' becomes a dignity meter with damage events and threshold states.

away.description: What loss this drive avoids, with the avoidance behavior.

low_state.description: State name entered when the meter bottoms out. Must name an entry in states.

logic_weight.x-consumer: appraisal pass decision scoring (logic/feeling framework; Haiku judges qualitatively, code weights)
logic_weight.description: Baseline logic share; feeling = 1 - logic. Context modulation is engine policy, not card data. Divergent scores emit the computed state 'conflicted' as an acting note.

defense_filters.x-consumer: appraisal pass write-middleware — sits between perception events and ledger writes to defended subjects
defense_filters.description: The mutability knob: plasticity IS defense strength; there is no separate plasticity field. Escalation is the one write that breaks through.

defends.description: Subjects protected: self_concept keys (self.actual etc.) or belief subjects.

states.x-consumer: appraisal/psyche pass (active-state tracking) -> briefing acting notes
states.description: Triggers are STIMULI, not moods (C3). Precedence is the engine constant. Multi-stage collapses (Rey) are chained states.

trigger.description: A condition a model can evaluate: 'interrupted twice in one exchange', never 'when disrespected'.

fragment.description: <=10 words of dialogue. If you cannot write it, you do not know the state (C2).

energy_map.x-consumer: GM briefing register band (posture's sibling: situation -> register)
energy_map.description: Situation key -> register band. Suggested bands: hushed, guarded, level, animated, unbound.

tells.x-consumer: GM briefing acting notes — GM knows who is watching, so the right tell ships per scene (C7)

escalation.x-consumer: appraisal pass gated permanent writes — the one write big enough to pass maximal defense filters (C11)
escalation.description: Cannot be skipped is structural: no other write path reaches maximally defended beliefs.

only.description: The one thing that permanently moves them.

carry_over.x-consumer: GM offscreen queue — deferred consequences fire at the next scene with the relevant person (C12)
carry_over.description: The bridge rule for payloads that land after the scene ends.

monologue.x-consumer: FUTURE actor call (per-character dialogue model: card + ledger + monologue, nothing else). NEVER the narrator — total capture is its job description there and a defect everywhere else.
monologue.description: 60-120 words, first person, from inside the distortion (D1). Glancing blows intact (D2) — the eventual reader is supposed to fall all the way in. May close with 'This is who you are.'
